topic: What feed element spacing balance minimizes dB loss while maintaining beamforming flexibility in defocused systems?
consensus_response: Defocused reflectors minimize dB loss by spreading signal power, increasing interference.  However, this tradeoff necessitates careful optimization of array factor via precoding techniques like digital beamforming to mitigate inter-element interference and maintain desired coverage & performance.  Larger spacing reduces interference but increases power consumption, impacting capacity. A balance is required between aperture and interference mitigation for optimal system performance.
